title: classroom50/actions/v1
description: Machine-readable schema for <classroom>/actions.json, the classroom's opt-in list of manual (workflow_dispatch) actions surfaced in the web app. Hand-authored; no CLI reads it, and the web app only reads it. The app can discover every dispatchable workflow in <org>/classroom50, but a workflow appears in the UI only because it is declared here — default deny, since a custom workflow can act outside the classroom (push grades to an external system, mail students). The declaration carries policy only: input types (type/required/choice options) stay in the workflow YAML, so the two cannot drift.

workflow.description: Workflow file name inside .github/workflows of the config repo, e.g. "moodle-sync.yaml". One entry per workflow; a repeated workflow keeps its first declaration.

label.description: Menu label. Also the label the app-wide Actions banner shows for the run: the banner's built-in workflow labels cover only the four scaffolded workflows.

description.description: Shown in the run dialog. Say what the action does outside GitHub, if anything.

min_role.description: Lowest classroom role offered the action. UX only — GitHub enforces the real boundary through Actions write on the config repo — but a workflow that writes to an external system should say so here rather than leave it inferred.

inputs.description: Per-input policy, keyed by the input name as the workflow declares it. An input not named here is treated as "hidden": silence must not expose a field, least of all one whose empty value widens a run's scope (a blank `classroom` reads as "every classroom" to more than one workflow). A REQUIRED input that ends up hidden makes the whole action unusable — the app reports it as needing configuration instead of dispatching into a 422.

policy.description: locked: fixed value, not editable — the only policy that guarantees a value the client cannot widen. shown: an editable field, starting at `value` or the workflow's own default. hidden: not shown and not sent, so the workflow's default applies.

value.description: The fixed value for `locked`, or the starting value for `shown`. Supports the placeholder {{classroom}}, substituted with the classroom the action was launched from.
